list_boards.title: List boards
list_boards.description: List every board in the Canny workspace (feedback boards such as Feature Requests or Bug Reports), with id, name, privacy and post count. Use the board ids with list_posts, list_categories and list_tags.

output.description: An object whose `boards` array holds board objects.

get_board.title: Retrieve a board
get_board.description: Fetch one board by its Canny id: name, creation time, privacy settings, post count and admin URL. Use list_boards to find the id.

list_categories.title: List categories
list_categories.description: List post categories, newest first, optionally only for one board. Returns `categories` plus `hasMore`; page with skip and limit. Categories are per board; use change_post_category to assign one to a post.

board_id.description: Only return categories of this board.

limit.description: How many categories to return (max 10000). Defaults to 10.

skip.description: How many records to skip before returning results, for offset pagination. Defaults to 0.

get_category.title: Retrieve a category
get_category.description: Fetch one post category by its id, including its board, parent category id, post count and filtered board URL.

create_category.title: Create a category
create_category.description: Create a post category on a board, optionally as a sub-category of another. Returns the new category id. Use change_post_category to put posts into it.

board_id.description: The board to create the category on.

subscribe_admins.description: Whether admins are subscribed to the new category.

parent_id.description: Id of the parent category, to create a sub-category.

output.description: An object with a single `id` key holding the new record's Canny id.

delete_category.title: Delete a category
delete_category.description: Delete a post category. Fails if the category still has sub-categories. Returns "success".

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

list_changelog_entries.title: List changelog entries
list_changelog_entries.description: List changelog entries (title, markdown and plaintext details, status draft/scheduled/published, types, labels, linked posts). Returns `entries` plus `hasMore`; page with skip and limit.

label_ids.description: Only entries carrying at least one of these label ids.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 10.

skip.description: How many records to skip before returning results, for offset pagination. Defaults to 0.

list_changelog_entries.notes: Translated entries can be requested with an Accept-Language header, which this tool does not set.

create_changelog_entry.title: Create a changelog entry
create_changelog_entry.description: Create a changelog entry, optionally publishing it now, back-dating it, or scheduling it, and optionally emailing users. Can link posts and labels. Returns the new entry id.

notify.description: Email users once published. Defaults to false.

published_on.description: With published=true, a past publish date (ISO 8601).

scheduled_for.description: Future publish date (ISO 8601) to schedule the entry.

label_ids.description: Labels to assign; each label 1-30 characters.

post_ids.description: Post ids to link to the entry.

output.description: An object with a single `id` key holding the new record's Canny id.

create_changelog_entry.notes: With notify and published both true, users are emailed and that cannot be undone.

list_comments.title: List portal comments
list_comments.description: List portal comments on posts, newest first, filtered by post, board, author or company. Cursor paginated: returns `items`, `hasNextPage` and `cursor`. Use get_comment for a single comment.

author_id.description: Only comments by this author (Canny user id).

company_id.description: Only comments by users linked to the company with this custom identifier.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `cursor`; pass it to fetch the next page.

limit.description: How many records to return (1-100). Defaults to 10.

get_comment.title: Retrieve a portal comment
get_comment.description: Fetch one portal comment by id: author, post, board, text value, images, internal/private flags, likes and parent comment.

create_comment.title: Create a portal comment
create_comment.description: Post a comment (or reply) on a post as a given author, optionally internal-only and optionally notifying voters. Returns the new comment id. Use create_or_update_user first to get the author's Canny id.

author_id.description: Canny id of the comment author.

post_id.description: Canny id of the post to comment on.

value.description: Comment text, under 2500 characters. Optional when image_urls are given.

internal.description: Internal-only comment; the author must be a company member. Defaults to false.

parent_id.description: Id of the comment this replies to.

should_notify_voters.description: Allow this comment to trigger email notifications. Defaults to false.

created_at.description: Original creation date (ISO 8601) when importing from another source.

output.description: An object with a single `id` key holding the new record's Canny id.

delete_comment.title: Delete a portal comment
delete_comment.description: Delete a portal comment by id. Returns "success".

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

list_companies.title: List companies
list_companies.description: List companies (customer organisations linked to users), ordered by creation date, optionally searched by name or filtered by segment. Cursor paginated; with search, hasNextPage is always false.

segment.description: URL name of a segment to filter companies by.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `cursor`; pass it to fetch the next page.

limit.description: How many records to return (1-100). Defaults to 10.

list_companies.notes: Served by Canny's v2 API. Companies are created by associating them with a user via create_or_update_user.

update_company.title: Update a company
update_company.description: Update a company's name, domain, monthly spend, creation date or custom fields. Company-sync integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, SSO) may overwrite these values. To create a company, associate it with a user via create_or_update_user.

domain.description: Bare domain such as acme.com (no protocol or path).

monthly_spend.description: Monthly recurring revenue in dollars, rounded to two decimals.

created.description: When the company was created in your system (ISO 8601).

custom_fields.description: Custom fields map; keys up to 30 characters, string values under 200 characters.

output.description: An object with a single `id` key holding the new record's Canny id.

delete_company.title: Delete a company
delete_company.description: Delete a company by the identifier you used when creating it. Returns "success".

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

list_groups.title: List groups
list_groups.description: List idea groups (hierarchical product areas used to organise ideas). Cursor paginated: `items`, `hasNextPage`, `cursor`.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `cursor`; pass it to fetch the next page.

limit.description: How many records to return (1-100). Defaults to 50.

get_group.title: Retrieve a group
get_group.description: Fetch one idea group by its id or url_name (give one of them): name, description, parent group and url_name.

list_ideas.title: List ideas
list_ideas.description: List ideas (feature requests / feedback items in Canny's ideas model) with optional filtering, sorting, search and parent filter. Cursor paginated: `items`, `hasNextPage`, `cursor`. Search does not support pagination or sorting. For board posts use list_posts.

search.description: Only ideas matching this search query.

parent_id.description: Only child ideas of this idea id.

filtering.description: Filtering object: {filters: [{resource: 'ideaDefaultField', condition, value: {fieldID, value}}], filtersOperator: 'all'|'any'}. Field ids include author, board, category, created, description, group, owner, status, tags, title, type; conditions depend on field type (e.g. is, isNot, contains, isOneOf, isBefore, isAfter).

sort.description: Sort object {field, direction: 'asc'|'desc'}. Defaults to {field: '_id', direction: 'desc'}.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `cursor`; pass it to fetch the next page.

limit.description: How many records to return (1-100). Defaults to 50.

get_idea.title: Retrieve an idea
get_idea.description: Fetch one idea by id or url_name (give one): title, description, status, group, owner, author, parent, source and child count.

merge_ideas.title: Merge ideas
merge_ideas.description: Merge one idea into another (merge_idea_id is folded into into_idea_id), recording the merging user. Returns "success". Use merge_posts for board posts.

merge_idea_id.description: Id of the idea to merge away.

into_idea_id.description: Id of the idea that absorbs it.

merger_id.description: Canny user id recorded as performing the merge.

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

delete_idea.title: Delete an idea
delete_idea.description: Delete an idea by id. Returns "success".

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

list_insights.title: List insights
list_insights.description: List insights (pieces of feedback attached to ideas, with author, company, priority, source and text), optionally for one idea. Cursor paginated: `items`, `hasNextPage`, `cursor`.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `cursor`; pass it to fetch the next page.

limit.description: How many records to return (1-100). Defaults to 50.

get_insight.title: Retrieve an insight
get_insight.description: Fetch one insight by its Canny id: text value, idea id, priority, author, company, users and source.

list_opportunities.title: List opportunities
list_opportunities.description: List CRM opportunities (synced from Salesforce or HubSpot) linked to posts and ideas, with value, stage, won/closed flags. Returns `opportunities` plus `hasMore`; page with skip and limit.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 10.

skip.description: How many records to skip before returning results, for offset pagination. Defaults to 0.

list_posts.title: List posts
list_posts.description: List posts (feedback on boards), optionally filtered by board, author, company, tags, statuses or search text, and sorted. Returns `posts` plus `hasMore`; page with skip and limit. Use get_post for one post.

author_id.description: Only posts by this author (Canny user id).

company_id.description: Only posts by users linked to the company with this custom identifier.

tag_ids.description: Only posts tagged with at least one of these tag ids.

search.description: Only posts matching this search query.

sort.description: Sort order. Defaults to newest; relevance requires search.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 10.

skip.description: How many records to skip before returning results, for offset pagination. Defaults to 0.

get_post.title: Retrieve a post
get_post.description: Fetch one post by id, or by url_name plus board_id: title, details, status, score, author, owner, category, tags, ETA, custom fields, linked Jira/Linear/ClickUp issues and roadmaps.

board_id.description: Board of the post; only needed when fetching by url_name.

create_post.title: Create a post
create_post.description: Create a post on a board on behalf of an author (optionally recorded as created by an admin), with category, owner, ETA, images and custom fields. Returns the new post id. Use create_or_update_user first to get the author's Canny id.

author_id.description: Canny id of the post author.

by_id.description: Canny id of the admin creating the post on the author's behalf.

owner_id.description: Canny id of the user responsible for the work.

eta.description: Estimated completion month as MM/YYYY, e.g. 06/2026.

eta_public.description: Show the ETA to all users.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields map; keys up to 30 characters, string values under 200 characters.

created_at.description: Original creation date (ISO 8601) when importing from another source.

output.description: An object with a single `id` key holding the new record's Canny id.

update_post.title: Update a post
update_post.description: Update a post's title, details, ETA, images, owner or custom fields. image_urls replaces existing images. Changing owner needs changer_id. Use change_post_status, change_post_category or change_post_board for those fields.

eta_public.description: Show the ETA to all users.

image_urls.description: Replacement image URLs; an empty list removes all images.

owner_id.description: Canny id of the admin to make owner. Requires changer_id.

changer_id.description: Canny id of the admin making the change; required with owner_id.

custom_fields.description: Custom fields map; keys up to 30 characters, string values under 200 characters.

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

change_post_status.title: Change a post's status
change_post_status.description: Change a post's status (open, under review, planned, in progress, complete, closed or a custom status), recorded as an admin's action, optionally with a comment and notifying voters. Returns the updated post.

status.description: New status, e.g. open, under review, planned, in progress, complete, closed, or a custom status.

changer_id.description: Canny id of the admin recorded as changing the status.

should_notify_voters.description: Notify non-admin voters of the change.

comment_value.description: Comment to attach to the status change.

comment_image_urls.description: Image URLs for the status-change comment.

change_post_status.notes: Setting the current status again returns the post but triggers no side effects. With should_notify_voters, emails go out and cannot be recalled.

change_post_category.title: Change a post's category
change_post_category.description: Assign a post to a category, or pass category_id "null" to remove its category. Returns the updated post.

category_id.description: Category id; the string "null" removes the category.

change_post_board.title: Move a post to another board
change_post_board.description: Move a post to a different board. Returns "success".

board_id.description: Canny id of the destination board.

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

merge_posts.title: Merge posts
merge_posts.description: Merge one post into another (merge_post_id is folded into into_post_id, combining votes), recording the merging user. Returns "success".

merge_post_id.description: Id of the post to merge away.

into_post_id.description: Id of the post that absorbs it.

merger_id.description: Canny user id recorded as performing the merge.

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

add_post_tag.title: Add a tag to a post
add_post_tag.description: Tag a post. Both ids are Canny ids; the tag must belong to the post's board. Returns the updated post (no change if already tagged).

remove_post_tag.title: Remove a tag from a post
remove_post_tag.description: Remove a tag from a post. Returns the updated post (no change if the tag was not on it).

delete_post.title: Delete a post
delete_post.description: Permanently delete a post by its Canny id. Returns "success".

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

link_jira_issue.title: Link a Jira issue to a post
link_jira_issue.description: Link a Jira issue (by key, e.g. PROJ-123) to a Canny post. Requires Canny's Jira integration. Returns "success".

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

unlink_jira_issue.title: Unlink a Jira issue from a post
unlink_jira_issue.description: Remove the link between a Jira issue and a Canny post. Requires Canny's Jira integration. Returns "success".

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

list_status_changes.title: List status changes
list_status_changes.description: List post status changes, newest first, optionally for one board, with the changer, new status, post and attached comment. Cursor paginated: `items`, `hasNextPage`, `cursor`.

board_id.description: Only status changes on this board.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `cursor`; pass it to fetch the next page.

limit.description: How many records to return (1-100). Defaults to 10.

list_tags.title: List tags
list_tags.description: List post tags, newest first, optionally for one board. Returns `tags` plus `hasMore`; page with skip and limit. Tags are per board.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 10.

skip.description: How many records to skip before returning results, for offset pagination. Defaults to 0.

get_tag.title: Retrieve a tag
get_tag.description: Fetch one tag by id: name, board, post count and filtered board URL.

create_tag.title: Create a tag
create_tag.description: Create a tag on a board (returns the existing tag if one with that name already exists). Use add_post_tag to apply it to posts.

list_users.title: List users
list_users.description: List end-users in the Canny workspace. Cursor paginated with limit (1-100) and cursor. Use get_user to look one up by email or your app's user id.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `cursor`; pass it to fetch the next page.

limit.description: How many records to return (1-100). Defaults to 10.

output.description: The page of users, with `hasNextPage` and `cursor`.

get_user.title: Retrieve a user
get_user.description: Fetch one user by exactly one of: Canny id, your application's user_id, or email. Returns name, email, admin flag, companies, custom fields and last activity.

user_id.description: The user's id in your application (SSO or API-created users only).

create_or_update_user.title: Create or update a user
create_or_update_user.description: Create a user, or update the existing one matched by id, user_id or email, setting name, alias, avatar, custom fields and company associations. Returns the user's Canny id for use as author_id / voter_id in create_post, create_comment and create_vote.

user_id.description: User's id in your application; needed to associate companies.

id.description: User's Canny id, to update a known user.

avatar_url.description: URL of the user's avatar image.

created.description: When the user was created in your system (ISO 8601).

custom_fields.description: Custom fields map; keys up to 30 characters, string values under 200 characters.

companies.description: Companies to associate the user with (adds, never removes). Each: {id, name, created?, domain?, monthlySpend?, custom_fields?}.

output.description: An object with a single `id` key holding the new record's Canny id.

create_or_update_user.notes: One of email, user_id or id must identify the user when updating. Admin users' email, name and avatar cannot be changed via the API.

delete_user.title: Delete a user
delete_user.description: Delete a user and all their comments and votes; their posts lose the author, or are removed if they have no other activity. Returns "success".

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

remove_user_from_company.title: Remove a user from a company
remove_user_from_company.description: Disassociate a user from a company they belonged to; their votes stop counting toward that company's spend. Returns "success".

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

list_votes.title: List votes
list_votes.description: List votes, newest first, filtered by post, board, user or company. Cursor paginated: `items`, `hasNextPage`, `cursor`.

company_id.description: Only votes by users linked to the company with this custom identifier.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response's `cursor`; pass it to fetch the next page.

limit.description: How many records to return (1-100). Defaults to 10.

get_vote.title: Retrieve a vote
get_vote.description: Fetch one vote by id: voter, post, board, admin who cast it on the voter's behalf, priority and any Zendesk ticket.

create_vote.title: Create a vote
create_vote.description: Vote on a post as a user, optionally cast by an admin on their behalf and with a priority. Returns "success" (also when the vote already exists). Use create_or_update_user to get the voter's id.

by_id.description: Canny id of the admin casting the vote on the voter's behalf.

vote_priority.description: Priority: 0 nice to have, 10 important, 20 must have.

created_at.description: Original vote date (ISO 8601) when importing from another source.

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

delete_vote.title: Delete a vote
delete_vote.description: Remove a user's vote from a post. Returns "success" (also when no such vote exists).

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

enqueue_autopilot_feedback.title: Enqueue feedback for Autopilot
enqueue_autopilot_feedback.description: Queue a call transcript or chat conversation for Canny Autopilot, which extracts feature requests and finds duplicates on its next sync. Each call uses one Autopilot credit. Returns "success".

conversation_id.description: Unique id of the conversation or call being enqueued (payload.id).

author_id.description: The author's id in your application (payload.authorID).

text.description: Transcript or conversation text to extract feature requests from (payload.text).

source_url.description: Link to the conversation or call (payload.sourceURL).

source_type.description: Source label such as twitter, zoom or intercom (payload.sourceType).

output.description: The string "success" when Canny accepted the change; otherwise an error object.

enqueue_autopilot_feedback.notes: Requires an Autopilot plan; manual mode caps the inbox at 100 unprocessed items.
